facts.label: Contando uma surpresa
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para o momento: I was walking in when everybody shouted.

facts.label: Ação longa
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para o que estava acontecendo: We were hiding. She was baking all morning. Use were com you, we e they, e was com I, he, she e it.

facts.label: Momento
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o momento: You came in. Everybody shouted. Combine com when: I was walking in when everybody shouted. A ação longa fica com -ing.

pages.title: A party room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday evening in a party room in Bristol. Colorful balloons hang from the ceiling. Bia stands near the door with a smile. Her friend Nate comes in and stops. Everyone shouts “Surprise!” Confetti falls on his head.
“Bia! What a surprise! I was walking in when everybody shouted.” says Nate. “Ha! We were hiding behind the sofa for an hour.” says Bia. “I saw a banner and some balloons. Who made them?” says Nate.
